directions.plain: We pick your best photos and show them to more women like your buyers. You spend a little each day and we keep what works.
directions.title: Boost Your Best Wearing Photos
directions.why_for_you: Your on-hand photos get the most response, so we would back those first. Last month came in above the expected range, so interest is there to build on.
directions.you_would_do: Post three to five times a week using mostly on-hand shots and pick two winners to back with ad money.

directions.plain: You lower prices for a single week and tell followers when it ends. Shoppers who were waiting choose to buy now.
directions.title: Run One Simple Discount Week
directions.why_for_you: Sales have lifted buying a lot for you in the past. Your on-hand shots can carry the news well.
directions.you_would_do: Post four to five times that week with mostly on-hand and close-up shots and remind people when the sale ends.

directions.plain: You share new photos almost every weekday and spend nothing extra. You grow slowly from people who already follow you.
directions.title: Post Often With No Extra Spend
directions.why_for_you: Your on-hand photos already get the most response. Our past checks were right most weeks, so this is a safe base.
directions.you_would_do: Post four to five times a week with mostly on-hand shots plus a few close-ups and flat lays.

directions.caution: Last month only one of a few creators posted, so this can be slow and uneven.
directions.plain: You mail free pieces to small creators your buyers follow. They try them on and share wearing photos if they like them.
directions.title: Send Pieces To New Creators
directions.why_for_you: Creator wearing shots tend to earn strong response when they do post.
directions.you_would_do: Message about ten creators, ship up to eight pieces, and ask for on-hand wearing photos.

season_note: December brings strong shopping interest at 1.57 with higher ad prices at 1.27 so favor low-cost posts and a clear sale.
